findings.title: WebView remote debugging enabled unconditionally in release builds
JavaScript bridge exposed to a WebView that can load remote content
Auto backup enabled with no backup rules
Exported lookup activity accepts arbitrary external intents and is BROWSABLE
Local content server on loopback reachable by other apps
Release build has no code shrinking or obfuscation, and lint errors do not fail the build
Verbose URL logging in release code
Play Console declarations needed: Data safety and privacy policy
